newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Pictet cuts earnings estimate for Nestle.
newsitem.headline: Pictet cuts earnings estimate for Nestle.

text.p: Swiss bank Pictet & Cie said it had cut its earnings per share estimate for Nestle SA to reflect lower sales forecasts and reduced operating margins, but had maintained its hold rating for registered shares.

"On the back of slightly lower sales forecasts and lower operating margins, we have trimmed our EPS estimates for 1996 to 80.9 Swiss francs (from 83.6 francs previously) and for 1997 to 89.1 francs (from 95.6)," it said in a research note.

"Among its peers, Nestle remains our favourite food stock and, although prospective earnings growth is clearly below that of the market, it is difficult to find a viable alternative to this heavyweight large-cap stock. The stock remains a hold by default."
